## Summary

Describe the CLI, API integration, response handling, documentation, or security change.

## Checklist

- [ ] TypeScript builds without errors
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, private prompts, or sensitive responses are committed
- [ ] `.env.example` contains placeholders only
- [ ] Non-2xx responses and missing fields are handled
- [ ] Rate-limit, timeout, and network failure behavior was considered
- [ ] Model-generated citations are not presented as independently verified
- [ ] Terminal logs do not expose credentials or sensitive payloads
- [ ] Dependency and lockfile changes are intentional
- [ ] README or examples were updated when behavior changed
- [ ] The change is compatible with the repository license

## Test Evidence

Provide commands run, sample redacted output, and any provider/model assumptions relevant to review.
